item.title: ScrollMate 1.0.0 (11)
item.description:
ScrollMate 1.0.0

  • A teleprompter panel that never appears in screen sharing, screen recording or a screenshot, and stays above fullscreen apps including a PowerPoint slideshow.
  • Console across the top of the panel: progress ring, talk clock, time remaining, the section you're in and the one coming next, and a live badge confirming the panel is still hidden.
  • The hidden state is checked against the window server every five seconds for as long as the app is running, and warns you if it ever changes.
  • Scrolling is manual by default — the script holds still until you press play, and a click on it always stops it.
  • Speed is set in lines per second over one fixed range, the same travel on the panel slider and in Settings.
  • Hold Option for a contents list of the script's headings; click one to jump to it.
  • Scripts are plain .txt or .md with headings, bold, italic, underline, bullets and [cue lines].
  • Settings for typeface, size, line spacing and colour, with a live preview, plus a Usage pane that never leaves your Mac.
  • In-app help, a menu bar icon rather than a Dock icon, and automatic updates checked against a signing key.
